lede: The biggest thing on the docket this week is Tuesday's HARC meeting, where the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W. Pacific Ave. goes before the commission for three separate Preliminary Large-Scale public hearings covering multiple new buildings in Backman Village — that's a significant chunk of the west end, and it's open to the public. Also Tuesday, San Miguel County holds its sixth working session on the Land Use Code rewrite, drilling into zoning, density, and regulatory incentives aimed at making workforce and affordable housing easier to build — worth your attention if housing in this valley matters to you.
